name: Muireatach
text: Muireatach is a variant spelling of the name Muilearteach, the water form of the Cailleach Bheur in Scottish Gaelic tradition.

attributes.attribute: name of the Cailleach Bheur's water form

okr.objective: Documents Muireatach as recorded in MacKillop 2008 for the Public Celtic Encyclopedia.
key_results: Muireatach is a variant spelling of Muilearteach.
The name covers the water form of the Cailleach Bheur.
